name: Pong
author: Fabrizio Vitale
description: The classic Pong: move your paddle up and down, return the ball and score when your opponent misses.

descriptions.en: The classic Pong: move your paddle up and down, return the ball and score when your opponent misses.
descriptions.it: Il classico Pong: muovi la racchetta in su e in giù, rimanda la palla e fai punto quando l'avversario la manca.
